spec.description: Shows how much of a dataset's size is held by live data, and how much are snapshots.
spec.title: Dataset Size Breakdown

spec.expr:
label_replace(
  2 * max by (name) (node_systemd_unit_state{name=~"syncoid-.*\\.service", state="failed"})
  + max by (name) (node_systemd_unit_state{name=~"syncoid-.*\\.service", state=~"activating|active"}),
  "dataset", "$1", "name", ".*tank-(.*)\\.service"
)

label_replace(
  2 * max by (name) (node_systemd_unit_state{name=~"syncoid-.*\\.service", state="failed"})
  + max by (name) (node_systemd_unit_state{name=~"syncoid-.*\\.service", state=~"activating|active"}),
  "dataset", "$1", "name", ".*tank-(.*)\\.service"
)

spec.description: Shows dataset size over time logarithmically, because we care about seeing movement over time, which is difficult when some datasets are dwarfed in linear scale.
spec.title: Dataset Sizes over Time
